Task: Structured Document Extraction

Write Python code that extracts merchant, tax, total, and items from a receipt using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
import os
from typing import List, Dict, Any

from google.cloud import documentai_v1 as documentai

def extract_receipt_data(
    project_id: str,
    location: str,
    processor_id: str,
    file_path: str,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Extracts merchant, tax, total, and items from a receipt using Google Cloud Document AI.
    """
    # Create a client
    client = documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient()

    # The full resource name of the processor
    # e.g., projects/project_id/locations/location/processors/processor_id
    name = client.processor_path(project_id, location, processor_id)

    # Read the file into memory
    with open(file_path, "rb") as image:
        image_content = image.read()

    # Configure the process request
    request = documentai.ProcessRequest(
        name=name,
        raw_document=documentai.RawDocument(
            content=image_content, mime_type="application/pdf" # Or "image/jpeg", "image/png" etc.
        ),
    )

    result = client.process_document(request=request)
    document = result.document

    # Initialize extracted data dictionary
    extracted_data = {
        "merchant": None,
        "tax": None,
        "total": None,
        "items": []
    }

    # Extract entities
    for entity in document.entities:
        if entity.type_ == "merchant_name":
            extracted_data["merchant"] = entity.mention_text
        elif entity.type_ == "total_amount":
            extracted_data["total"] = float(entity.mention_text) if entity.mention_text else None
        elif entity.type_ == "tax_amount":
            extracted_data["tax"] = float(entity.mention_text) if entity.mention_text else None
        elif entity.type_ == "line_item":
            item = {}
            for prop in entity.properties:
                if prop.type_ == "line_item/description":
                    item["description"] = prop.mention_text
                elif prop.type_ == "line_item/amount":
                    item["amount"] = float(prop.mention_text) if prop.mention_text else None
            if item:
                extracted_data["items"].append(item)

    return extracted_data
